senses.gloss:
Ved. (इरज्यति-ते) 
__1 To grow. 
__2 To be jealous. 
__3 To order, prepare; arrange, dispose of. 
__4 To be master of. 
__5 To lead.
a. Ved. Engaged in preparations for the sacrificial rite; विश्वेषामिरज्यवो देवानां बार्महः [[Rv. 10. 93. 3.]]

__1 A desert. 
__2 Salt or barren ground; cf. इरिण.

a. [cf. [[P. III. 2. 37]]] Delighting in drinking, an epithet of Agni; इरम्मदं वृहदुक्थं यजत्रम् [[Vāj. 11. 76.]] 
-दः 
__1 A flash of lightning, the fire attending the fall of a thunderbolt; इरम्मदमिव मेघमालाऽसूत [[K. 70.]] 
__2 The submarine fire.

Ved. 
__1 To behave insolently, be angry. 
__2 (With dat.) To be ill-affected towards.

__1 Ill will, malevolence; इरस्या द्रुग्धो भियसा नि गारीत् [[Rv. 5. 40. 7.]] 
__2 Wish for food.

[इ-रन् [[Uṇ. 2. 28]]; इं कामं राति रा-क वा [[Tv.]]] (‘इरा तु मदिरावारिभारत्यशनभूमिषु’ इति विश्वलोचनः) 
__1 The earth. 
__2 Speech. 
__3 The goddess of speech, Sarasvatī, 
__4 Water. 
__5 Food; इरावतीं धारिणीं भूधराणाम् [[Mb. 13. 26. 95.]] 
__6 Spirituous liquor. 
__7 Any drinkable fluid; a draught (especially of milk). 
__8 Refreshment, comfort (Ved. in the last three senses). 
__9 N. of one of the wives of Kaśyapa. 
-Comp. 
-ईशः 
__1 N. of Varuṇa, of Viṣṇu, of Gaṇeśa and of Brahman; इतीरेशेऽतर्क्ये निजमहिमनि स्वप्रमितिके [[Bhāg. 10. 13. 57.]] 
__2 a king, sovereign. 
-क्षीर a. Ved. whose milk is a refreshment [Page0388-2] or enjoyment; यज्ञपदीराक्षीरा स्वधाप्राणा महीलुका [[Av. 10. 10. 6.]] 
(-रः) the milk ocean. 
-चर a. 
__1 earth-born, terrestrial. 
__2 aquatic. 
(-रम्) hail; so इरावरम्. 
-जः N. of Kāma or Cupid. 
-वेल्लिका pimples on the head or, pimples on the face produced at the time of puberty (Mar. मुरुमाची पुटकुळी).

a. 
__1 Granting drink or refreshment, satiating. 
__2 Endowed with provisions, comfortable. आत्मा हि जज्ञ आत्मनः स इराबत्यतितारिणी [[Ait. Br.]] VII. 13. m. 
(-वान्) 
__1 Ocean. 
__2 A cloud. 
__3 A king. 
__4 N. of a son of Arjuna. 
-ती 
__1 N. of a river in the Panjab (रावी). 
__2 N. of a plant. 
__3 N. of Durgā, Rudra's wife.

a. [ईर-ल्युट्] Agitating, driving. 
-णः The wind. 
-णम् 
__1 Agitating, moving, driving. 
__2 Going. 
__3 = इरण q. v.
